review_scope: human-reported video observations and scientific decisions; not independent frame-level verification

summary.interpretation: Small selected human-reviewed pilot; not a population yield estimate. Graph approval does not imply formal Seen/Gold or experimental generalization evidence.

reviews.original_question: How many flags of the country whose flag is on the flagpole atop the building with the gold clock are on the stage when Putin delivers the first speech?
user_observations: A shows Putin's first-speech stage and five Russian flags among flags of multiple countries.
B shows the gold-clock building and a Russian tricolor.
A alone cannot resolve which national flags are referenced by the building in B; B alone cannot count stage flags.
caveats: Exact flagpole-top spatial relation was not separately frame-verified.
Window times are source references, not precise certified event boundaries.

reviews.original_question: What is Brittany's relationship to the person shown at 00:02?
user_observations: A at 00:02 shows a Black woman with short hair and a red shirt.
A subtitle at approximately 01:18 identifies Tacara; user confirms identity binding through consistent appearance and context.
B at approximately 14 seconds relative to B displays subtitle 'Brittany (Tacara's sister)'.
B alone cannot identify the person referred to at 00:02.
caveats: A subtitle is near the A-window end boundary (78s); inspect actual clip inclusion before any downstream use.
Appearance match is user-reported, not independent frame-level identity certification.

reviews.original_question: What did the man do after kissing the woman's hands during the Vancouver 2010 performance that was done while wearing a white dress?
reviews.historical_answer: He got down on one knee
user_observations: Both A and B identify the performance.
B shows hand kissing and the subsequent action.
User explicitly confirms B alone is sufficient to answer the original question.
caveats: Historical action wording 'got down on one knee' was not separately transcribed from the user observation.
Retain as shortcut diagnostic, not approved compositional candidate.

reviews.original_question: Which company does the presenter mention before the company that claims to first to provide AI-powered business insights from secondary data?
user_observations: A mentions ServiceNow and Cohesity in that order.
A alone establishes ServiceNow-before-Cohesity mention order.
caveats: Not independently confirmed whether A alone contains the descriptive clue identifying Cohesity as the company claiming AI-powered insights from secondary data.
A/B windows overlap approximately three seconds.
Do not overstate full-question A-only sufficiency as proven.

reviews.original_question: Which player scored the tenth point for the country whose flag is being waved at the beginning of the video in the first set of the video?
user_observations: A shows female supporters waving an Italian flag.
B shows Italy playing Brazil, with Italian player number 5 scoring.
User confirms B depicts Italy's tenth point in the first set.
B can identify Italy, but cannot determine which country's flag was waved at the beginning; that referent requires A.
Either team could reach ten points, so recognizing Italy in B is not enough to select the target country without A.
correction_history: Initial B-only shortcut classification was based on incorrectly equating B's ability to identify Italy with B's ability to resolve the question's flag-defined target country.
User corrected that the flag in A selects the queried country; both teams can potentially score a tenth point.
User explicitly approved corrected v0.2 directed graph.
caveats: Semantic referent necessity is user-supported; no model ablation or shortcut-resistance experiment has yet been run.

cursor_handoff.action: Ingest as an auditable scientific review artifact only; retain raw user observations and correction history; validate against source packs and manifest before writing repository records.
do_not: Do not silently rewrite source evidence.
Do not promote candidates to formal Seen, Gold, or Unseen.
Do not freeze pool or mark train_exposed.
Do not start expensive Track A RSI.
Do not treat SP003/SP004 as approved compositional graphs.
Do not reinstate SP005's retracted B-only shortcut label.
